chunks: Indeed, the husband is one of the witnesses.

key_terms.اَلزَّوْجَ: the husband, in the context of legal testimony
key_terms.اَلشُّهُودِ: the witnesses in a legal matter
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or reported

ai.seo_question: Can a husband be counted as one of the witnesses in a legal case?
ai.summary: This report states a legal principle that the husband may be counted among the witnesses. It relates to jurisprudential questions of testimony within the context of legal punishment for slanderous accusation.
